data.name: Le Jardin Malanga Hotel
data.description:
Located 7 km from Grande Anse beach, this tranquil hotel with ocean views is 4 km from both the center of Trois Rivieres village and Parc Archéologique des Roches Gravées.
Rustic rooms have minifridges and iPod docks; some offer private bathrooms. Cottages add extra bedrooms and private terraces with lounge chairs.
There's a restaurant serving traditional French cuisine, plus a pool with a sundeck. Continental breakfast is available for a fee (free for children age 11 and under).
